eventDetail.scope: The RTSI (Research and Technologies for Society and Industry) Forum, the flagship conference of the IEEE Italy Section and an IEEE Region 8 portfolio conference, brings together researchers and industry professionals across IEEE technical fields to foster collaboration between academia and industry. The conference promotes the exchange of innovative research and technological solutions while increasing awareness of the positive impact that engineering and technology can have on society, industry, and quality of life.
